Stacks of paper and chaotic file folders are a thing of the past – the future of document management is Kydo. The solution for businesses looking to manage their documents efficiently and digitally. Kydo is more than just a storage space for data. It helps automate workflows, optimize document management, and bring order to your office.

What is Kydo?

Kydo is a modern document management solution developed by EUTIMA AG. Over the past four years, a user-friendly software was created with passion and expertise, enabling businesses to not only store documents but manage them intelligently. Whether for trustees, SMEs, accountants, or developers – Kydo offers tailored features for every industry.

Your benefits with Kydo

  • Flexible document management: The intuitive interface allows for personalized document organization – without paper clutter.
  • Automated document processing: Invoices and receipts are processed automatically and transferred to accounting, saving time and reducing manual errors.
  • 100% Swissmade: Kydo securely stores your data in Switzerland, ensuring top-level data protection and trust.
  • Easy integration: Kydo seamlessly integrates into existing applications, making it ideal for developers customizing their systems.

Kydo Use Cases

Kydo provides tailored solutions for every business:

  • For trustees: Manage your clients and streamline document processing digitally.
  • For SMEs: Benefit from a scalable DMS that grows with your company.
  • For accountants: Automate your accounts payable workflow and save valuable time.
  • For developers: Easily integrate Kydo into your applications with our free API.

Why Kydo?

Kydo is more than just a document storage solution – it's a platform that takes document management to the next level. It saves time and helps businesses optimize their workflows efficiently.
